found_in_own_draft.what: The first workbook build applied percentage formatting to the wrong column, so a text column would have displayed as a percentage while the numeric percentage column stayed unformatted.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: reading the number-format map against the sheet headers before the first recalculation
found_in_own_draft.fix: The number-format map was corrected, the workbook rebuilt, and the native Excel probe now reports the expected formula count with zero error cells.

found_in_own_draft.what: The first guide build placed a page break after every one of 31 sections, producing a 57-word page and several half-empty pages.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: rendering page 7 and reading its word count (57) after the first build
found_in_own_draft.fix: Removed the per-section breaks, kept the text dense, and added eleven printable worksheets as the page-depth layer; the final guide is 30 pages and 12,662 gate words, with no page under 80 words.

found_in_own_draft.what: The first evidence model summed the net budget-line changes as 'approved rebudget' and got $0, while the workbook correctly reports $7,500 of approved transfers. Netting transfers across lines cancels them; the Summary is asking for the total approved, not the net.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: the independent-vs-Excel comparison disagreeing on Summary!B6 while every other field matched
found_in_own_draft.fix: The model now sums each approved request once for the total and separately applies the transfer to its source and destination lines for the revised budget; the field matches $7,500 and the revised budget stays $120,000.

found_in_own_draft.what: NCE Planner!B6 was hardcoded to 2026-05-31 (30 days before the end), while the guide said the workbook calculates the 10-day rule deadline. A user changing the award end date would keep a stale notice deadline.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: reading the workbook formula inventory against the guide's page 8 and page 13 claims
found_in_own_draft.fix: B6 is now =IF($B$3="","",$B$3-10); the guide, independent model, and expected notice date were updated to June 20, 2026 and 66 days.

found_in_own_draft.what: The Unspent Decision approval-required validation allowed only Yes/No/Not sure while the example rows used Not required, so valid example data was outside its own list.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: comparing the data-validation formula with the example values
found_in_own_draft.fix: Not required was added to the F2:F21 list.

found_in_own_draft.what: Rebudget Log!H counted an amount when an approval date was filled even if the request status was still Sent, so a pending request could change the budget before approval.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: reading the H formula against the guide's statement that a pending request has zero effect
found_in_own_draft.fix: H now counts only when the request requires no approval or its status is Approved; the independent model uses the same status rule.

found_in_own_draft.what: Summary!B20 added the award end date and closeout days without a blank guard; clearing the end date would display a 1900 date instead of a blank.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: testing the summary formula chain against optional inputs
found_in_own_draft.fix: B20 now returns a blank unless both inputs exist.

found_in_own_draft.what: The Summary had no check that the total award equals the original budget, and its open-rebudget count ignored blank statuses on real request rows.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: reviewing the check list against the workbook's own fields
found_in_own_draft.fix: Added B34 award-vs-original-budget check and changed B15 to count every non-terminal request with a row.

found_in_own_draft.what: Example dates were stored as text even though they carried date number formats, making formulas depend on locale-specific implicit coercion.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: reading openpyxl data types for Award Profile, Unspent Decision, Rebudget Log, Funder Rules, and Communication Log
found_in_own_draft.fix: The builder now writes real date values for every example date input; formula cells remain formulas.

found_in_own_draft.what: The Rebudget Log accepted free-text from/to lines and unvalidated amounts, so a typo could silently break the SUMIF budget change.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: checking the sheet's validations against its stated control purpose
found_in_own_draft.fix: Added a Budget vs Spend line list for E:F and a non-negative decimal rule for G:H.

found_in_own_draft.what: The guide contained stale or contradictory claims: ACF was described as a 10-day rule using a dead URL, the final report was described as due in 30 days, the final reconciliation and refund pointers did not match the checklist, and the denial example omitted the $1,000 unallocated balance.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: reading the full extracted guide text against the workbook tasks, formulas, and source pages
found_in_own_draft.fix: Corrected the ACF deadline and URL to the current OCSE/RCD pages, corrected NIH/NSF sources, aligned the report/reconciliation/refund language with the checklist, and changed the denial example to $7,000.

found_in_own_draft.what: The listing copy still said the workbook has 371 live formulas and eleven Summary checks, while the rebuilt workbook has 373 formulas and twelve checks.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: comparing every numeric claim in the listing copy against the rebuilt workbook before packaging
found_in_own_draft.fix: The copy now states 373 formulas and twelve checks; a permanent test compares those claims to the workbook itself.
